plugins.Name: Time Memoria
plugins.Description: Quest progression and pacing — a reflective notebook for your story journey, not a scoreboard.
plugins.Punchline: Remember every step, Warriors of Light.
plugins.Changelog:
Map:
- Click a quest's flag (Native) or its Area column (Classic) to open the game's own map at the spot it's picked up. Classic's version was broken since it first existed -- it passed the wrong coordinate format into the map link, so it never actually opened anywhere.
- A handful of quests sit in interior rooms the game has no map graphic for; those are quietly skipped rather than opening to an error.

Native:
- Maintenance and Active Events now show the same detail Classic always has -- countdowns, start and end times, and a note when a festival is running in game but hasn't reached the news feed yet.
